description: This file defines API endpoints for a job portal backend, including user management, profile management, job postings, and applications, utilizing FastAPI, SQLAlchemy ORM, and dependency injection for authentication and authorization.

methods.name: create_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user, creates user and profile if role is job seeker.

methods.name: get_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current logged-in user's info.

methods.name: get_user(user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieve a user by ID, admin only.

methods.name: update_user( user_id: int, user: UserUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Update user info, self or admin.

methods.name: delete_user( user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Delete a user account, admin only.

methods.name: update_profile( profile: ProfileUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.job_seeker)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
create_job(job: JobCreate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.employer)))
methods.description: Create a new job posting, employer role required.

methods.name: list_jobs( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Free-text search"), location: Optional[str] = None, remote: Optional[bool] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = Query(None, description="Filter by skills/tags"), skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, )
get_job(job_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific job posting.

methods.name: update_job(job_id: int, job: JobUpdate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.employer)))
methods.description: Update an existing job posting, employer role required.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: int, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.employer)))
methods.description: Delete a job posting, employer role required.

methods.name: create_application(app: ApplicationCreate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.job_seeker)))
methods.description: Submit a job application as a job seeker.

methods.name: get_application(app_id: int, current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve application details, with access control.

methods.name: list_my_applications(current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: List all applications submitted by the current user.
